nora: Heads-up: shipping SDK wheel shows AsyncIterator return types as AsyncIterator[object] in the distributed .pyi, breaking mypy for streaming endpoints. pyright unaffected.

ash: Repro: async for e in client.stream_logs(id): if isinstance(e, LogChunk): print(e.lines) -> mypy: Item of "AsyncIterator[object]" has incompatible type.

kevin: Looks like pyi generator drops the union on stream returns. local source ok, wheel pyi wrong.

maya: Workarounds: cast the iterator (`cast(AsyncIterator[Union[LogChunk, StreamErr]], client.stream_logs(...))`) or pin to a wheel from main. Not ideal.

kevin: Plan: patch generator to emit explicit Literal discriminator on chunk models and ensure pyi contains the union. Add wheel-unpack mypy smoke test in CI. PR incoming.

ci-bot: PR #923 opened by kevin  CI smoke test will run.

nora: Also add docs blurb and an example showing the temporary cast. Backport to maintenance branch after merge.

maya: noted, will update examples and docs.

kevin: tagging `bug:py-sdk-typing` and `area:packaging`.
